comments.snippet:
I went through the list on the current `v1.78.2-dev` (25ef453a). Everything in it is still in the code, but some of it is a design decision rather than a bug, and some fixes cost more than they look:

- **H-1 (`mR3m`)**: it is the key of a connections file without a master password of its own, which is what lets such a file open on any machine and for any user, from a share for instance. A master password is the way out today; changing the default is a product decision more than a fix.
